notes.title: Demo V1.2
notes.content:
First,
A HUGE THANK YOU to all who played the McBelle Manor Demo this far! It has been fun looking over the gameplay video's, streams, and feedback popping up! 

Yesterday, I uploaded V1.2 of the demo that brings some fixes:

The player could get softlocked in the kitchen corner after convo with Cera - FIXED
Overall gamesize has been compressed down to ~8GB.
While continuing to work on the full release, I will continue to update the demo with new content/fixes! 

 My next GOAL is to get FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT implemented so menus and the inventory can be navigated w/controllers.

Stay tuned and THANK YOU again for your support! :)
